title: A negative limiting correction preserves positive total energy
statement: Explicit piecewise-polynomial compatible Hessian/normal-curl fields have disjoint supports while Poisson/Hodge extension acts on the stressed region;admitted smooth approximations exist. At a=2^186,corrected energy falls~3.36e-37 while total Jensen gap~48.0859 stays positive. Separate earlier example keeps26.2444%gap reduction versus .9004%total-energy reduction. Coordinator ran only both producer-authored frozen receivers with normalized scientific payload equality,not an independent authored audit or computational proof of universal classification/Gamma convergence. Capital does not rerun them.
